articles.title: Workload Identification with Physical Side Channels for AI Governance
articles.summary: Researchers show that GPU workloads on an NVIDIA H200 can be classified using external power-draw traces, distinguishing AI training, AI inference, and non-AI computation with 97% accuracy in their test corpus. The work suggests physical side channels could support AI compute verification for governance because they are harder to spoof than on-chip telemetry, though adversarial evasion remains an open challenge.
articles.advisor_relevance: This is an early technical signal that AI governance may increasingly focus on monitoring how advanced GPUs are used, not just who owns them. If such methods mature, they could influence compliance requirements for frontier AI labs, cloud operators, and data center infrastructure providers, but the current work remains academic and not yet a commercial or regulatory deployment.
